description_html:
The Vaporesso XROS 3 Nano Pod Kit is a compact square-shaped refillable pod system with adjustable airflow, AXON chip with Pulse Mode, and compatibility with all XROS pods.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 1000mAh
  • Charging: USB Type-C
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 2mL
  • Coil Type: Integrated Mesh
  • Coil Resistance: 0.6Ω (included)
  • Activation: Draw-Activated
  • Airflow: Adjustable Slider
  • Display: None
  • Fill Method: Top Fill
  • Pod Compatibility: All Vaporesso XROS Pods (0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.0Ω, 1.2Ω)
  • Brand: Vaporesso

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
